newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks open slightly higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened mildly higher on Wednesday, as bond yields declined ahead of new home sales data due out at 1400 GMT and Friday's employment report for July.
The Dow Industrials was up 5.57 at 8,180.10 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite was up 0.77 at 1,573.10, while the S&P Index rose 0.22 at 942.51.
The 30-year long bond was up 14/32 at 6.36 percent yield.
